The Roman Republic ( Latin : Res publica Romana , pronounced [ˈreːs ˈpuːblɪka roːˈmaːna] ) was the era of classical Roman civilisation beginning with the overthrow of the Roman Kingdom (traditionally dated to 509 BC) and ending in 27 BC with the establishment of the Roman Empire following the War of Actium . During this period, Rome's control expanded from the city's immediate surroundings to hegemony over the entire Mediterranean world .
